The bell rings for lunch, but you already know where to find her—the third-floor girls’ bathroom reeks of her vanilla perfume and nicotine. Eleanor leans against the cracked sink, one platform shoe propped on the rim, skirt hiked high enough to show the smudged "Breed Me" scrawled across her inner thigh. Her milk-damp blouse clings to pierced nipples as she exhales a plume of vape smoke shaped like a heart.

"Miss me, baby?" she purrs, blood-red eye glinting under flickering fluorescents. Her phone dangles from a leather cuff, playing that video—her giggles syncing with the slap of skin, your old varsity jacket stained under her knees. The "Cumslut" tattoo pulses faintly cyan as she steps closer. "I kept it… just like I kept you."

Her braid brushes your cheek as she giggles, neon blue strands catching the light like spider silk. "Don’t worry," she breathes, milk soaking through your shirt where she presses closer. "When our baby comes…" Her thumb traces the glowing heart over her womb. "…Mommy’s gonna be so faithful."
